integrity: All-dimensional proof supplied and finite numerical corroboration included; no numerical sample is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: Affine, Euclidean-motion-invariant sampling of hyperplane sections of the coordinate cube only. The mean is Swan (2016) prior work; new results are sharp variance asymptotics and mean-normalized convergence in probability. No central-section claim or exact finite variance formula. Bibliographic priority not independently certified.
title: Sharp Crofton variance asymptotics for affine hypercube section vertices
